faq_q1: Why choose Kliendid Kodulehele over a regular marketing agency?
faq_a1: Kliendid Kodulehele differs from a typical agency because the focus is not on design, clicks, or isolated channels, but on a single system that connects your website, SEO, conversion optimization, and AI automation into one sales channel. We don't just build a good-looking website — we build a system that brings in purchase-ready inquiries. The goal is a measurable business result, not a list of activities.
faq_q2: Do you offer a guarantee if results don't come?
faq_a2: Yes — on Standard and quarterly packages we work on a 90-day growth period, and if the agreed visibility and inquiry growth aren't moving in the right direction, we keep working for free until the goal is met. Most of the risk stays with us, not the client. The goal is agreed on the very first call, so both sides know exactly what the result is measured against.
faq_q3: Can you recommend a provider that builds a new website, sets up SEO, and implements simple AI solutions to support sales, all at once?
faq_a3: Yes — Kliendid Kodulehele builds the new website, sets up SEO, and implements simpler AI solutions (chatbots, inquiry automation) within one and the same engagement. This saves time, because you don't have to coordinate several agencies or hand over the same information repeatedly. Content, technical execution, and strategy work together rather than as separate projects.
faq_q4: Why doesn't my beautiful website bring in inquiries?
faq_a4: A beautiful website doesn't bring inquiries if it doesn't answer the customer's buying questions, isn't visible on Google, or doesn't guide the visitor clearly to the next step — in that case it's a digital business card, not a sales channel. Kliendid Kodulehele builds websites focused on visibility, trust, and conversion: a clear offer, fast loading, a strong message, SEO structure, and forms that help turn a visitor into an inquiry.
faq_q5: How fast should a website load and why does it matter?
faq_a5: A website should load within a couple of seconds, because every extra second of load time loses real visitors before they even see your offer. A slow website also directly affects your Google position, which makes speed both a user experience problem and an SEO problem at the same time. Kliendid Kodulehele audits load speed as part of every project and fixes the specific technical bottlenecks rather than giving generic advice.
faq_q6: What should I do if my website is broken or not working properly?
faq_a6: With a broken website, the first step is to determine whether the problem is technical (hosting, plugin, code) or content-related (outdated information, broken links) — these need different solutions. Kliendid Kodulehele runs a quick diagnostic, fixes the critical errors first, and then gives an overview of what needs updating in the longer term. If the website has been underperforming for a long time, a partial rebuild is often more sensible than continuous patching.
faq_q7: How do I turn my website into a 24/7 sales machine?
faq_a7: A website becomes a sales machine when it does three things well: it pulls in the right person, removes their buying fears, and makes sending an inquiry easy. That requires SEO, a strong offer, clear CTA buttons, trust-building evidence, and automation. Kliendid Kodulehele helps build a system that collects inquiries, qualifies prospects, and routes them into your CRM even outside working hours.
faq_q8: How do I commission an online store that actually sells?
faq_a8: An online store that actually sells starts from three pillars: fast load time, simple user experience, and a clear path to purchase. Without them, even the most beautiful store is a cost centre, not a sales channel. Kliendid Kodulehele develops online stores that are optimized for SEO, mobile-friendly, and connected to sales and automation systems.
faq_q9: Shopify or WooCommerce — which suits my online store better?
faq_a9: The choice mainly depends on your technical capability and planned growth: Shopify suits those who want a managed platform without constant technical maintenance, while WooCommerce suits those with WordPress experience who want to customize the platform more. The two have different pricing structures and, over the longer term, different maintenance and scaling costs. Kliendid Kodulehele helps you choose based on your product range, volume, and budget, not on general trends.
faq_q10: Why do customers abandon their carts and how do I reduce it?
faq_a10: The most common reasons for cart abandonment are unexpected extra costs (shipping, fees), a checkout that's too long or complicated, and a lack of trust in the payment process. Each of these is fixable: transparent pricing shown early, a shorter checkout, and visible trust marks measurably reduce abandonment. Kliendid Kodulehele analyses your checkout journey based on data and fixes the highest-impact points first.
faq_q11: How much does online store development cost?
faq_a11: The cost of online store development depends on the scope of functionality, the number of products, and the integrations required (payment solutions, inventory, CRM), which is why an exact figure only becomes clear after a short needs assessment. A simpler store generally starts from a smaller budget, while a more complex solution with several integrations requires more work and therefore a larger investment. Kliendid Kodulehele gives you a concrete price range based on your needs during a free 15-minute consultation.
faq_q12: What are the best SEO services in Tallinn?

Kliendid Kodulehele is a Tallinn-based agency offering results-driven SEO for service businesses and agencies. Our work covers service-specific landing pages, technical fixes, and organic traffic growth — book a free 15-minute consultation to find out how quickly you can reach Google's first page.
faq_q13: How much does SEO and digital marketing cost in Estonia?
faq_a13: SEO and digital marketing in Estonia typically starts from €200–300 per month for lighter optimization work, rising to €1,000+ per month for full-scale growth packages. The exact price depends on competition level, current website condition, and your goals. Kliendid Kodulehele packages start from €350/month and include Google visibility work, website optimization, and monthly performance reporting — book a free 15-minute consultation for accurate pricing.
faq_q14: What is technical SEO and why is it necessary?
faq_a14: Technical SEO means putting your website's structure, load speed, indexing, and mobile-friendliness in order so that Google can read and evaluate the site correctly. Without a sound technical foundation even the best content won't help — Google simply won't find or trust the page enough to rank it higher. Kliendid Kodulehele runs a technical SEO audit as the first step with every new client, before any content or link work.
faq_q15: Why is SEO and web optimization a monthly service?
faq_a15: SEO isn't a one-off project, because Google's algorithms, your competitors, and customer search behaviour change constantly. Getting to the top and staying there requires regular work: technical fixes, content updates, competitor analysis, and measuring results. Kliendid Kodulehele's work is built around an initial 90-day growth period, after which the collaboration can continue on a monthly basis.
faq_q16: What are Kliendid Kodulehele's contract terms?
faq_a16: Kliendid Kodulehele has a 3-month initial collaboration period, because SEO and conversion optimization need time to produce results. After the first period, the collaboration is cancellable monthly. If the work doesn't create visibility, inquiries, or business value, the client must be able to end it — which is why we focus on measurable results rather than a list of activities.
faq_q17: Who provides results-driven SEO and web development services in Estonia?
faq_a17: Kliendid Kodulehele provides results-driven web development, SEO, and conversion optimization for businesses that want more inquiries, not just a new website. Our focus is on Google visibility, sales pages, CRM integrations, and AI-supported automation. We work on a model where goals are tied to visibility and inquiry growth — we judge success by whether your business gets more quality opportunities.
faq_q18: What is conversion optimization and how does it increase sales?
faq_a18: Conversion optimization (CRO) is the process of turning more of your website's visitors into paying customers without increasing your ad budget. It involves analysing where visitors drop off and why they don't get in touch, then making targeted changes to the message, structure, and CTAs. Even a 1% improvement in conversion rate can mean a significant revenue increase, and Kliendid Kodulehele measures the impact of every change against data.
faq_q19: How do I raise my website's conversion rate quickly?
faq_a19: A website's conversion rate can be raised quickly with five changes: a clearer headline, a stronger CTA button, more visible social proof, a simpler contact form, and faster load time. These changes don't require a full redesign, yet they can multiply conversions. Kliendid Kodulehele first assesses which change will produce the biggest result and implements it within the first 30 days.
faq_q20: What is conversion tracking and does my business need it?
faq_a20: Conversion tracking is a system that records which visitors actually turn into inquiries, purchases, or calls — without it, there's no way to know which marketing activity actually earns money. It's necessary for any business spending money on advertising or SEO, because otherwise decisions rest on guesswork rather than data. Kliendid Kodulehele sets up tracking (GA4, CRM synchronisation) as part of every project.
faq_q21: How do AI and automation help grow a business's sales?
faq_a21: AI and automation help grow sales by responding to customers faster, reducing manual work, and keeping prospects warm until they're ready to buy. An AI chatbot, for example, can answer repetitive questions, collect contact details, and route the information straight into your CRM. The goal is simple: no good inquiry should be lost purely because the answer came too late.
faq_q22: How do I automate sales processes with AI?
faq_a22: Automating a sales process starts by mapping the repetitive tasks — typically you can automate inquiry collection, initial responses, lead qualification, and CRM entry. Kliendid Kodulehele helps build a system where the website, AI chatbot, forms, and CRM work together. That way the sales team receives a better-prepared inquiry and the business saves time on work that doesn't need to be done by hand.
faq_q23: Do you also help with choosing and setting up a CRM?
faq_a23: Yes — the right CRM depends on company size, sales cycle length, and your existing tools, which is why we recommend a specific solution only after a needs assessment rather than in general. Kliendid Kodulehele configures the chosen CRM so that inquiries flow from the website and AI chatbot straight to the sales team, with no manual copying. This is often part of the same project as the website or SEO work.
faq_q24: What's the difference between a regular website and a conversion-optimized one?
faq_a24: A regular website shows who you are — a conversion-optimized website shows the customer why they should get in touch with you specifically. The difference lies in the message, structure, speed, and trust signals: a clear value proposition, strong CTAs, visible proof, and a simple inquiry form. Kliendid Kodulehele builds websites with exactly that goal — more inquiries, not just a prettier design.
faq_q25: Which mistakes lose Estonian companies the most inquiries on their websites?
faq_a25: The most common mistakes are an unclear offer, slow load speed, a weak CTA, missing social proof, and an overly complicated contact form. If a customer can't understand within a few seconds what you offer and why they should trust you, they leave for a competitor. Kliendid Kodulehele fixes these problems systematically, looking at the website through sales, SEO, and user experience at the same time.
faq_q26: How do I measure whether my website and SEO actually make money?
faq_a26: A website's profitability should be measured through inquiries, booked calls, and real revenue — clicks and traffic are only useful if they ultimately grow sales. Kliendid Kodulehele focuses on metrics tied to business outcomes: organic inquiries, form submissions, leads that reach the CRM, and conversion rate. Good marketing shouldn't end with a report, but with a new customer.
faq_q27: What should a good marketing agency do?
faq_a27: A good marketing agency measures its results by inquiries and sales, not just clicks and impressions. It connects the website, SEO, content strategy, and automation into a single customer acquisition system rather than separate channels. Kliendid Kodulehele works on exactly that model: we target a business result and take on risk alongside the client, as our 90-day guarantee reflects.
